_comment: Outside sources this map routes to. One entry per source. `adopted` = declared in kattakath/nix-config today; a candidate is vetted but not declared. Checked is the date the stars/activity/claims were last verified. INDEX.md is generated from this file: edit here, then run scripts/build-index.py.

sources.name: claude-plugins-official
sources.use_for: First-party and partner plugins: skill-creator, claude-md-management, hookify, security-guidance, frontend-design.

sources.name: claude-plugins-community
sources.consume: search its .claude-plugin/marketplace.json (2,282 entries, each pinned to a commit and security-scanned); declare picked plugins only
sources.use_for: The widest vetted plugin search. Query before building anything.

sources.name: skills.sh + find-skills
sources.consume: find-skills skill; `curl https://skills.sh/api/search?q=<term>`; `npx skills find` (never `add` under a harness)
sources.use_for: Skill search ranked by install count. Bar: 1K+ installs, repo 100+ stars.

sources.name: Official MCP Registry
sources.use_for: MCP server search. Adoption goes through nix-config's mcp-scout, never `claude mcp add`.

sources.name: trailofbits/skills
sources.consume: marketplace, or cherry-pick skill dirs from the pinned flake input (as nix-config does)
sources.use_for: Security and GitHub-CLI skills, heavily tested. CC-BY-SA-4.0.

sources.name: obra/superpowers
sources.consume: cherry-pick skill dirs from the pinned flake input
sources.use_for: Engineering discipline skills (systematic-debugging adopted; writing-skills overlaps skill-creator).

sources.name: wshobson/agents
sources.consume: marketplace `claude-code-workflows`: 94 small plugins, declare one at a time
sources.use_for: General engineering agents and skills by language and domain. Finest-grained large collection.

sources.name: EveryInc/compound-engineering-plugin
sources.use_for: Plan, work, review, compound workflow; the most eval-tested collection. ce-compound's keep-or-drop test is already borrowed by harvest.

sources.name: johnpapa/ai-ready
sources.use_for: Mine a repo's PR review comments into AGENTS.md, weighting recent ones and flagging superseded conventions.

sources.name: awesome-claude-code
sources.consume: THE_RESOURCES_TABLE_NEW.csv (with Active / Last Checked / Stale columns)
sources.use_for: Tools, hooks and workflows that are not packaged as plugins.
